## RYANAIR ADDS NEW BOURNEMOUTH-TOULOUSE ROUTE FOR SUMMER 2027


**GIVING CUSTOMERS THE CHANCE TO BOOK EARLY AND AVAIL OF THE LOWEST FARES**


Following the announcement of its new Bournemouth to Porto Summer 2027 route last month, Ryanair, the UK’s No.1 low fares airline, has today (Wed, 18 Nov) launched another exciting new Summer 2027 route from Bournemouth to Toulouse, which will operate twice per week (Mon & Fri) from 4 June 2027.


Known as the “Pink City” because of its distinctive terracotta-brick architecture, Toulouse is one of France’s most vibrant and charming destinations. Nestled in the south-west of the country, it combines rich history, beautiful streets, and a lively cultural scene with a warm, relaxed atmosphere. Visitors can explore stunning landmarks such as the Basilica of Saint-Sernin, wander along the scenic banks of the Garonne River, and enjoy the bustling cafés and markets that give the city its unique character.


Ryanair’s new Bournemouth to Toulouse route is available to book now via the Ryanair app/website.


**Ryanair’s Director of Comms, Jade Kirwan, said:**


*“Following the launch of our new Porto route for Summer 2027 last month, we’re pleased to be back with more good news for our customers in the South West as we launch another exciting new Summer 2027 route from Bournemouth – this time to Toulouse – a stunning city in the south-west of France.* *Toulouse is renowned for its unique blend of culture, history, gastronomy, and innovation, making it an ideal choice for everything from a weekend city break to a longer summer holiday. Whether you want to explore the city’s beautiful architecture, enjoy its famous food scene, or discover the wider Occitanie region, this new route offers even more choice at Europe’s lowest fares.* **


*This exciting new Ryanair route from Bournemouth to Toulouse will operate twice weekly from 4 June 2027 and is available to book now via the Ryanair app/website* .”


**Steve Gill, Managing Director at Bournemouth Airport, said:**


*“This is more great news for our customers and adds another fantastic European destination next summer. With a growing cultural offer, amazing food scene and the perfect gateway to southern France, Toulouse was recently named as one of the world’s top cities to watch. We’re delighted to be building on our long-standing partnership with Ryanair to offer even more choice from Bournemouth.”*
